title: Family First Communion Portrait, 1940s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white mid-1940s snapshot capturing a family standing on the steps of a wooden house porch. The young boy is dressed in a formal double-breasted suit with a white ribbon armband on his sleeve, indicative of a First Communion or confirmation ceremony. His parents stand behind him, with the mother wearing a short-sleeved floral dress and the father in a wide-lapel suit with a necktie. An older man wearing a hat and jacket stands near a vintage car parked in the background.
